peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 0.7% below its local comparables; 30 of 54 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (48.9): 3.1 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 43 of 91 similar developments with a figure (the same as 3). Context, not scored: resales in 66.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,250,000 ($1,399 psf, 850–1,001 sq ft; 7 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 7 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,321 psf (range $1,177–1,441); 5.9% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $70,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $1,557,500 ($1,289 psf, 1,173–1,313 sq ft; 8 resales, Jul 2024–Jun 2026); 8 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,391 psf (range $1,295–1,999); 7.3% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $123,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Kembangan MRT about 120 m, Eunos MRT about 970 m; closer than 85 of 94 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 9 within 2 km; nearest ST. Stephen's School about 660 m; more than 19 of 94 similar developments (the same as 24). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 300 m), more than 22 of 94 similar developments (the same as 12); nearest hawker centre Eunos Crescent Blk 4a about 840 m; nearest park Telok Kurau Park about 560 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Straits at Joo Chiat, 3 new sales, about 780 m; K Suites, 6 new sales, about 1,040 m; Claydence, 8 new sales, about 1,060 m; Verdé Joo Chiat, 9 new sales, about 1,270 m; Koon Seng House, 6 new sales, about 1,280 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 321 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 32 new sales and 630 resales (662 purchases); new sales were 4.8% of these purchases. Subsales (4) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 630 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 79 of 94 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 630 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 737 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−14.5%). Planning-area private resales −7.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
